abilities.name: Thorned Nectar
abilities.text: Deals Lightning DMG equal to 1% of Aglaea's ATK to one designated enemy.

abilities.name: Rise, Exalted Renown
abilities.text: Restores HP to Garmentmaker by 0.5% of its Max HP. If Garmentmaker is absent, summons the memosprite Garmentmaker and this unit immediately takes action.

abilities.name: Dance, Destined Weaveress
abilities.text:
Summons the memosprite Garmentmaker. If Garmentmaker is already on the field, then restores its HP to max. Aglaea enters the "Supreme Stance" state and immediately takes action.
While in the "Supreme Stance" state, Aglaea gains the SPD Boost stacks from Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent, with each stack increasing her SPD by 0.15%. Enhances Basic ATK to "Slash by a Thousandfold Kiss," and cannot use Skill. Garmentmaker is immune to Crowd Control debuffs.
A countdown appears on the Action Order, with its own SPD set at 100. Using Ultimate again when the countdown is on the Action Order will reset the countdown. When the countdown's turn starts, Garmentmaker self-destructs. When Garmentmaker disappears, Aglaea's "Supreme Stance" state is dispelled.

abilities.name: Rosy-Fingered
abilities.text: The memosprite Garmentmaker has an initial SPD equal to 0.35% of Aglaea's SPD and a Max HP equal to 0.66% of Aglaea's Max HP plus 720. While Garmentmaker is on the field, Aglaea's attacks inflict the target with the "Seam Stitch" state. After attacking enemies in the "Seam Stitch" state, further deals Lightning Additional DMG equal to 0.3% of Aglaea's ATK. "Seam Stitch" only takes effect on the most recently inflicted target.

abilities.name: Meteoric Sunder
abilities.text: Summons the memosprite Garmentmaker and launches a forward joint attack. After entering battle, regenerates 30 Energy and deals Lightning DMG equal to 1% of Aglaea's ATK to all enemy targets. Then, randomly inflicts the "Seam Stitch" state to a random enemy target.

abilities.name: Thorned Snare
abilities.desc: Deals Lightning DMG equal to #1[i]% of ATK to one enemy and Lightning DMG equal to #2[i]% of ATK to adjacent targets.

abilities.name: A Body Brewed by Tears
abilities.desc: After attacking an enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch," increases this unit's SPD by #1[i] , stacking up to 6 time(s). When Garmentmaker takes action, automatically uses "Thorned Snare," prioritizing enemies under the "Seam Stitch" state.

abilities.name: The Myopic's Doom
abilities.desc: While in Supreme Stance, increases Aglaea's and Garmentmaker's ATK by an amount equal to 720% of Aglaea's SPD plus 360% of Garmentmaker's SPD.

abilities.name: Last Thread of Fate
abilities.desc: When Garmentmaker disappears, up to 1 stack(s) of the SPD Boost from the Memosprite Talent can be retained. When Garmentmaker is summoned again, gains the corresponding number of SPD Boost stacks.

abilities.name: The Speeding Sol
abilities.desc: At the start of battle, if this unit's Energy is lower than 50%, regenerates this unit's Energy to 50%.

abilities.name: Drift at the Whim of Venus
abilities.desc: The enemy afflicted with "Seam Stitch" takes 15% increased DMG. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker attacks this target, additionally regenerates 20 Energy.

abilities.name: Sail on the Raft of Eyelids
abilities.desc: When Aglaea or Garmentmaker takes action, enables the DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker to ignore 14% of the target's DEF. This effect stacks up to 3 time(s) and lasts until any unit, other than Aglaea or Garmentmaker, actively uses an ability.

abilities.name: Bequeath in the Coalescence of Dew
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10. Memosprite Talent Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Flicker Below the Surface of Marble
abilities.desc: The SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent has its max stack limit increased by 1. After Aglaea uses an attack, can also make Garmentmaker gain the SPD Boost effect from the Memosprite Talent.

abilities.name: Weave Under the Shroud of Woe
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Memosprite Skill Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Fluctuate in the Tapestry of Fates
abilities.desc: While Aglaea is in "Supreme Stance," increases her and Garmentmaker's Lightning RES PEN by 20%. When Aglaea's or Garmentmaker's SPD is greater than 160/240/320, the Joint ATK DMG dealt by them increases by 10%/30%/60%.
